Sid Meier's Alpha Centauri DEMO Welcome to the Sid Meier's Alpha Centauri DEMO version. The demo captures the early excitement of the game by providing a limited 100-turn single-player game. While playing you'll be able to build 10 bases and discover technologies up to level 5. You'll be able to select one of 7 unique factions, each with its own agenda and strategy.  The full version of Alpha Centauri lets you play through the entire game, including 5 pathways to victory, 32 secret projects with full motion video, more technologies, more units, multiplayer, maps and customizable options. The full version also includes considerably more art, sound, music, and animation. For more details see the splash screen when you exit the game.  To begin the game please select either "Quick Start" or "Start Game" from the menu which follows.
